record.text:
Jeremiah Fears leads Pelicans past Kings for first win of the season

— Jeremiah Fears had 22 points, a career-high 13 assists and eight rebounds to lead the New Orleans Pelicans to a 132-120 win over the Sacramento Kings on Thursday night.

record.text: You know, they're always calling the NBA, sports, a business. And business really sucks, gets in the way of superior competition. So how about the league start a hostile takeover against the Sacramento Kings and New Orleans Pelicans?
